verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a public web service, so whether it publishes a real robots.txt is a fair question. The only relevant evidence is a probe of efile.sunbiz.org/robots.txt, and it does not show a valid robots.txt with directives. The probe reports HTTP 200 but also says the host 'answers robots.txt with a server error', and an earlier dossier found the same host serving a page with no robots directives. No documentation mentions a robots.txt for the dos.fl.gov pages either. The probe's internal contradiction (HTTP 200 vs. server error) is why confidence is medium rather than high.
